source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Check if there is OTS brand or logo during POST

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria: 1. There shoul be OTS brand or logo during POST

historical_reviews.deepseek: NO; correctly identifies physical visual acceptance.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: MANUAL ONLY / IMPROVED; adds expected-logo reference, display path, controlled reboot and timestamped evidence.

original_test_intent: Visually confirm that the approved OTS brand/logo appears correctly on the display during POST.
original_method: Bind the expected logo reference and display path to the exact SUT/BIOS, perform one approved power-on/reboot, have an engineer observe and capture the transient POST screen, and correlate normal boot/event context.
manual_activity: A human must watch the physical POST display and judge the transient logo against the approved reference. Agent boot logs, SSH reachability or inventory cannot establish this visual result.
required_inputs: Approved OTS logo artwork/reference and allowed scaling/color/cropping
Exact display output/monitor/input and capture method
safety_requirements: Do not infer logo presence from SSH, BMC inventory, successful boot or framebuffer configuration.
Confirm the intended physical display input before reboot.
Use one approved boot attempt and stop on POST/display abnormality.
Preserve timestamped visual evidence and boot context.
agent_execution_scope: Prepare board/BIOS baseline, expected-logo comparison checklist and evidence metadata.
Analyze a supplied photo/video for visible differences and collect BMC/console/boot context.
Report observations without claiming the physical check or formal verdict.
engineer_actions: Approve the boot window and expected reference.
Observe/capture the physical POST display and confirm visual result.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Correct: no SSH command can prove a transient physical display image.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: No software substitution; retain direct observation with an approved camera/photo/video method.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: OTS brand/logo during POST, criterion and 30/30-minute fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.status: HUMAN VISUAL CORE WITH TRACEABLE CAPTURE
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Capture timestamped POST video/photo including board/test identity, compare it with approved logo artwork, and retain boot/SEL context.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Platforms exposing POST on the designated physical display.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BIOS/BMC build, display path and capture-device metadata.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Owner-approved OTS branding artwork and platform POST specification.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds reference-bound evidence and boot context without automating the visual verdict.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Remote KVM or compressed captures may alter color/scaling and must be approved if used.

project_override_considerations: A project may approve remote KVM capture, but must document that it represents the display path under test; generic boot logs remain insufficient.
expected_evidence: Board/BIOS identity, expected logo and display/capture setup
Timestamped photo/video of the logo during POST

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure and criterion consistently require OTS logo presence during POST; spelling does not change intent.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The visual intent is clear; missing reference/equipment are readiness inputs and MANUAL ONLY captures core acceptance.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains its reference/display/evidence improvements and MANUAL ONLY classification.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates agent image analysis from engineer observation and verdict.

review_improvement: Makes a fleeting POST observation reproducible without accepting unrelated system logs as visual evidence.
independent_technical_reasoning: Logo rendering is the display behavior under test and requires human visual confirmation. This is a canonical MANUAL ONLY case.
